People: Ármin Vámbéry (author, Wikidata Q557360), died 1913. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Vámbéry, Ármin, 1832-1913") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Travels In Central Asia, 1864, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/in.ernet.dli.2015.228469. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 61%, 100%, 82% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Ármin Vámbéry, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
